messages:
Alyssa (CS): Quick check on NovaPay beta enrollment — timeline slipped? They were aiming for next-week enablement. Marcus, you spoke with them last week.

Marcus (AE): Yep, spoke w/ their CTO. They're enthusiastic but legal wants a DP addendum before prod keys. Shared contract comments this morning. Pinged legal contact.

Marcus (AE): @Samir can you confirm staging readiness if legal signs by Fri?

Samir (Onboarding): Staging env is provisioned, sample data loaded, basic smoke tests pass. API keys are the only blocker (we hold until countersign). I can run enablement Wed or Thu next week — what works for NovaPay?

Samir (Onboarding): Draft invite we usually send:
```
Subject: NovaPay — Redwood beta enablement
When: Wed 10:00am PT (45m)
Agenda: quick architecture, integration checklist, test prompts, rollout guardrails, Q&A
Attendees: NovaPay eng + product, Marcus (AE), Samir (Onboarding), Alyssa (CS), Elena (PM)
Zoom: <link>
Notes: bring example payloads, share one failing prompt if any
```

Elena (PM): Heads up: they requested batched embeddings + prefix caching. There's a feature-flag `novapay-alpha-routing` that gates the routing optimization; I can enable it for them once legal confirms. Also they asked about approximate-cost estimates for 10M tokens/month.

CS-Bot: Reminder: NovaPay (acct:nova_123) status update: beta_flag=true, renewal_at_risk=false, last_customer_touch=3d, support_tickets_open=1

Alyssa (CS): Plan: Marcus to chase legal + confirm countersign by Fri, Samir to prep enablement materials and link (Wed 10am PT preferred), Elena to be ready to flip feature flag and provide token-cost estimate. I will create a post-session feedback thread and short eval form. @Marcus @Samir @Elena any blockers?

Elena (PM): No blockers on our side. I can have cost estimates by EOD Thu.

Samir (Onboarding): I'll be ready Wed 10am PT, will prepare quick-runbook and share a checklist in #docs after the call.

Marcus (AE): I'll follow up with legal today and update here. If countersign slips past Fri, we should still do a soft enablement (no prod keys) to keep momentum.

Alyssa (CS): Sounds good. I'll schedule the provisional slot and mark as provisional until Marcus confirms. After enablement I'll capture immediate feedback w/ 5-point eval and highlight any regression risk. :thumbsup:
